stem_book: In the arrangement shown in figure a₁, a₂, a₃ and a₄ are the accelerations of masses m₁, m₂, m₃ and m₄ respectively. Which of the following relation is true for this arrangement? (a) 4a₁ + 2a₂ + a₃ + a₄ = 0 (b) a₁ + 4a₂ + 3a₃ + a₄ = 0 (c) a₁ + 4a₂ + 3a₃ + 2a₄ = 0 (d) 2a₁ + 2a₂ + 3a₃ + a₄ = 0
work: a_P2 = −a₁ ; a₂ + a_P3 = 2a_P2 = −2a₁ ; a₃ + a₄ = 2a_P3 = −4a₁ − 2a₂ → 4a₁ + 2a₂ + a₃ + a₄ = 0
